title: State and Union Territory protected-area count and area summaries
description: Historical official summary of national parks and wildlife sanctuaries by state/UT. Not an inventory of named protected areas; source position January 2024. Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu is combined from the two source rows.

source.title: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation — EnviStats India 2024, Statement 1.12; source: Wildlife Institute of India National Wildlife Database
source.note: Counts and areas are the official table's historical position. DNH and Daman & Diu were separate source rows and are combined here for the current merged UT; Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are retained as separate rows as in the source.
